about: Guards one of your holdings: patrols within radius of it, strikes weaker enemy lords there (weighing each with every enemy lord and army in view that could join a fight with it within join_hours, so it never picks one lord out of a gathering army; breaking off a chase that would take it out of its area or has not closed in for 6 hours), and breaks sieges it can break (counting the defenders inside when they would sally out). From forces too strong for it, it shelters inside the holding when its garrison, militia and your lords there, with this lord, would hold it (the game's own test for whether besiegers should assault, with the walls' worth); if they would not, in the nearest castle or town of yours or an ally's that would, so it is not trapped and taken with a place that falls. With stay_inside 1 it goes in early enough to get there first: as soon as such forces are due at the holding (by the game's marching rules) sooner than it could ride back from the edge of its patrol, with six hours to spare, even with caution 0. Refilling: when its ranks fall below the floor and it is not needed there (it is not in an army, the holding is not besieged, and no enemy lord or army is within twice its radius of the holding), it refills in the nearest town or village of yours or an ally's, then comes back; it breaks off when enemy lords come near the holding, and leaves a place that yields few recruits in 12 hours, trying again two days later. A lord leading an army never leaves to refill by itself.
calls_back: a force too strong for it comes near the holding, the holding is besieged, it breaks or gives up a siege, it goes to refill, has refilled, broke off refilling or found few recruits, or the holding falls

radius: how far around the holding it patrols and watches, in map units
shelter_at: shelter when the forces threatening the area are this many times your side's strength there (this lord and your lords who could reach the holding within join_hours) (enemy lords, armies and bandits in view, every enemy lord and army that could reach the holding within join_hours, and armies seen there in the last 6 hours); it comes out again only once the area and half as far again beyond it are clear; with stay_inside 1, also when enemy lords and armies this strong are due at the holding before it could ride back from its patrol
strike_below: attack an enemy lord in the area, or the besiegers, up to this share of your side's strength (this lord and your lords who could join the fight within join_hours) (against besiegers, counting the defenders inside when they would sally out)
floor: go to refill when its ranks fall below this share of full, and only while it is not needed there (see above); 0: it never leaves to refill
stay_inside: 1: always shelter inside the holding itself, even when it would not hold (if it falls, the lord is taken with it); 0: inside only when it would hold, else in the nearest castle or town that would

when.poke: {at} fell, so {me} stopped defending it.

when.if: ranks < floor and not in_army and hours_running >= refill_again and not besieged(at) and enemy_threat_near(at, radius * 2) <= 0
when.poke: {me}'s ranks are {round(ranks * 100)}% and no enemy lord is near {at}; refilling at {refill_at}, then back.
{me} is breaking the siege of {at}: strength {relief_strength(at)} with the defenders inside who would sally out ({me}'s own {strength}) against {siege_strength(at)}.

set.refuge: pick(stay_inside > 0, at, pick(refuge(at, radius) != none, refuge(at, radius), at))

when.poke: A strong force besieges {at}: strength {siege_strength(at)} against {me}'s {strength}. {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.

when.if: stay_inside > 0 and fort(at) and relief_within(at, radius / max(pace, 0.3) + 6, radius) >= side_strength(at) * shelter_at
when.poke: Forces too strong for {me} are coming to {at} and would get there before {me} could ride back from its patrol: strength {relief_within(at, radius / max(pace, 0.3) + 6, radius)} against your side's {side_strength(at)}. Nearest first: {relief_of(at, radius)}. {me} is going inside {at} ahead of them.

set.refuge: pick(stay_inside > 0 and fort(at), at, pick(refuge(at, radius) != none, refuge(at, radius), pick(fort(at), at, nearest_fort())))

when.poke: Forces too strong for {me} are near {at}: strength {threat_near(at, radius)} against your side's {side_strength(at)}. {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.

when.if: within(at, radius) and easiest_enemy_near(at, radius) != none and (easiest_enemy_near(at, radius) != spurned or now >= spurned_until) and company(easiest_enemy_near(at, radius)) <= side_strength(easiest_enemy_near(at, radius)) * strike_below

when.poke: {at} fell, so {me} stopped defending it.

when.if: besieged(at) and not inside(at) and siege_strength(at) <= relief_strength(at) * strike_below
when.poke: {me} is breaking the siege of {at}: strength {relief_strength(at)} with the defenders inside who would sally out ({me}'s own {strength}) against {siege_strength(at)}.

when.if: hours_in_state >= 3 and not besieged(at) and threat_near(at, radius * 1.5) < side_strength(at) * shelter_at * 0.8 and (stay_inside <= 0 or relief_within(at, radius / max(pace, 0.3) + 6, radius * 1.5) < side_strength(at) * shelter_at * 0.8)

when.poke: {at} fell, so {me} stopped defending it.
{me} broke off refilling at {refill_at}: enemies came near {at}. Ranks {round(ranks * 100)}%.
{me} refilled to {round(ranks * 100)}% at {refill_at} and goes back to defending {at}.

when.if: refill_check >= 0 and hours_in_state >= refill_check + 12 and ranks < refill_from + 0.05
when.poke: {me} found few recruits at {refill_at} (ranks {round(ranks * 100)}% after 12 hours there) and goes back to defending {at}; it tries again in two days.
{me} has spent two days refilling at {refill_at} (ranks {round(ranks * 100)}%) and goes back to defending {at}; it tries again in two days.

when.if: not in_battle and not within(at, radius)
when.poke: {me} broke off the chase of {target}: it would have led {me} out of the area it guards ({distance(me, at)} from {at}). Back to patrolling; it leaves {target} be for 6 hours.
{me} gave up the chase of {target}: no closer in 6 hours ({distance(me, target)} away). Back to patrolling around {at}; it leaves {target} be for 6 hours.

when.if: not in_battle and company(target) > side_strength(target) * strike_below * 1.5
when.poke: {me} broke off the strike on {target}: with the enemies who could join a fight with it within {join_hours} hours it is strength {company(target)} against your side's {side_strength(target)}. Back to patrolling around {at}.

when.if: stay_inside > 0 and fort(at) and relief_within(at, radius / max(pace, 0.3) + 6, radius) >= side_strength(at) * shelter_at
when.poke: Forces too strong for {me} are coming to {at} and would get there before {me} could ride back from its chase: strength {relief_within(at, radius / max(pace, 0.3) + 6, radius)} against your side's {side_strength(at)}. Nearest first: {relief_of(at, radius)}. {me} is going inside {at} ahead of them.

set.refuge: pick(stay_inside > 0 and fort(at), at, pick(refuge(at, radius) != none, refuge(at, radius), pick(fort(at), at, nearest_fort())))

{at} fell.
The siege of {at} is broken.

when.poke: The besiegers of {at} grew too strong to strike; {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.

when.poke: Enemy forces besides the besiegers came near {at} (strength {threat_near(at, radius) - siege_strength(at)}); {me} broke off the relief and is sheltering in {refuge}.
